name: Pre-cleanup snapshot
body:
Anchor for E-OPEN-SOURCE-001 (open-sourcing the engine as Master Console, AGPL-3.0).

This release tags the LAST commit of the repository before any content cleanup or targeted history rewrite. Its purpose is a GitHub-clock timestamp of the untouched commit chain, so the prior-art evidence can be verified against a state that predates every edit made for the open-source release.

- Target commit: 5f0edc503748a2bf5449e3e83575769db58bf799 (branch session/2026-08-29)
- Headline evidence commits that must survive unchanged: cd37d410, 29908188, bb06646d, 38d771bf; tag warpos@0.1.4 -> de9ba8eb
- Planned rewrite (phase 3) removes only a small set of verbatim operator quotes and one personal email address, entering history no earlier than 2026-05-13. Nothing before that point is touched.
- A private mirror of the full untouched history (all branches + tags) was also taken at this commit.
